```{ojs}
//| label: chart-render
chart = {
  // Dimensions — square aspect ratio
  const container = document.getElementById("chart-container");
  const size = Math.max((container?.clientWidth || 520) - 30, 320);
  const W = size;
  const H = size;
  const margin = {top: 24, right: 24, bottom: 48, left: 52};
  const innerW = W - margin.left - margin.right;
  const innerH = H - margin.top - margin.bottom;

  // Color map
  const getColor = d => d.class === "Positive" ? "#1f77b4" : "#d62728";

  const symbolGenerator = d3.symbol();

  const getPath = (d, size) => {
    symbolGenerator.type(d.group === "Male" ? d3.symbolCircle : d3.symbolCross).size(size);
    return symbolGenerator();
  };

  // Scales
  const xScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4, 10]).range([0, innerW]);
  const yScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4, 10]).range([innerH, 0]);

  // Build/reuse SVG
  let svg = d3.select("#chart-container svg");
  if (svg.empty()) {
    svg = d3.select("#chart-container")
      .append("svg")
      .attr("width", W)
      .attr("height", H)
      .style("display", "block");
  } else {
    svg.attr("width", W).attr("height", H);
  }

  let defs = svg.select("defs");
  if (defs.empty()) defs = svg.append("defs");
  let clip = defs.select("#main-clip");
  if (clip.empty()) {
    clip = defs.append("clipPath").attr("id", "main-clip");
    clip.append("rect");
  }
  clip.select("rect").attr("width", innerW).attr("height", innerH);

  let g = svg.select("g.inner");
  if (g.empty()) {
    g = svg.append("g").attr("class", "inner")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);
  }

  let plotArea = g.select(".plot-area");
  if (plotArea.empty()) {
    plotArea = g.append("g").attr("class", "plot-area").attr("clip-path", "url(#main-clip)");
  }

  // Grid lines
  let gridGroup = g.select(".grid");
  if (gridGroup.empty()) gridGroup = g.append("g").attr("class", "grid");
  gridGroup.selectAll(".grid-h")
    .data(yScale.ticks(6))
    .join("line").attr("class","grid-h")
    .attr("x1", 0).attr("x2", innerW)
    .attr("y1", d => yScale(d)).attr("y2", d => yScale(d))
    .attr("stroke", "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)").attr("stroke-width", 1);
  gridGroup.selectAll(".grid-v")
    .data(xScale.ticks(6))
    .join("line").attr("class","grid-v")
    .attr("x1", d => xScale(d)).attr("x2", d => xScale(d))
    .attr("y1", 0).attr("y2", innerH)
    .attr("stroke", "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)").attr("stroke-width", 1);

  // Axes
  let xAxisG = g.select(".x-axis");
  if (xAxisG.empty()) xAxisG = g.append("g").attr("class","x-axis");
  xAxisG.attr("transform", `translate(0,${innerH})`)
    .call(d3.axisBottom(xScale).ticks(6).tickSize(4))
    .call(ax => {
      ax.select(".domain").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.15)");
      ax.selectAll("text").attr("fill","#64748b").attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
      ax.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.1)");
    });

  let yAxisG = g.select(".y-axis");
  if (yAxisG.empty()) yAxisG = g.append("g").attr("class","y-axis");
  yAxisG.call(d3.axisLeft(yScale).ticks(6).tickSize(4))
    .call(ax => {
      ax.select(".domain").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.15)");
      ax.selectAll("text").attr("fill","#64748b").attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
      ax.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.1)");
    });

  // Axis labels
  let xLabel = g.select(".x-label");
  if (xLabel.empty()) {
    g.append("text").attr("class","x-label")
      .attr("x", innerW / 2).attr("y", innerH + 40)
      .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("fill","#475569")
      .attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif")
      .text("Feature X  (Group Disparity axis)");
  }
  let yLabel = g.select(".y-label");
  if (yLabel.empty()) {
    g.append("text").attr("class","y-label")
      .attr("transform","rotate(-90)")
      .attr("x", -innerH / 2).attr("y", -40)
      .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("fill","#475569")
      .attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif")
      .text("Feature Y  (Class Separation axis)");
  }

  const getP = (g, c) => (g === "Male") ? (c === "Positive" ? params_mp : params_mn) : (c === "Positive" ? params_fp : params_fn);

  // Points
  const getX = d => {
    const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.group, d.original_class));
    return xScale(nx + (d.group === "Female" ? group_disparity : 0));
  };
  const getY = d => {
    const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.group, d.original_class));
    return yScale(ny + (d.original_class === "Positive" ? class_separation : 0));
  };

  plotArea.selectAll("path.point")
    .data(active_data, d => d.id)
    .join(
      enter => enter.append("path")
        .attr("class", "point")
        .attr("transform", d => `translate(${getX(d)},${getY(d)})`)
        .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 0))
        .attr("fill", getColor).attr("opacity", 0)
        .call(e => e.transition().duration(450)
          .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 60)).attr("opacity", 0.72)),
      update => update.call(u => u.transition().duration(450)
        .attr("transform", d => `translate(${getX(d)},${getY(d)})`)
        .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 60))
        .attr("fill", getColor).attr("opacity", 0.72)),
      exit => exit.call(x => x.transition().duration(280)
        .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 0)).attr("opacity", 0).remove())
    );

  // ── Decision boundary: training chart ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const drawContour = (targetG, xSc, ySc) => {
    const m = window._model;
    if (!m || !m.predictNorm) return;
    const GRID = 80;
    
    // Pad domain slightly so the closed edges of the contour fall outside the SVG clipPath
    const oX = xSc.domain(), oY = ySc.domain();
    const px = (oX[1] - oX[0]) * 0.1, py = (oY[1] - oY[0]) * 0.1;
    const xDom = [oX[0] - px, oX[1] + px], yDom = [oY[0] - py, oY[1] + py];

    const xStep = (xDom[1] - xDom[0]) / GRID, yStep = (yDom[1] - yDom[0]) / GRID;
    const Wg = GRID + 1, Hg = GRID + 1;
    const vals = new Float64Array(Wg * Hg);
    for (let r = 0; r < Hg; r++) {
      const yv = yDom[1] - r * yStep;
      for (let c = 0; c < Wg; c++)
        vals[r * Wg + c] = m.predictNorm(...m.norm(xDom[0] + c * xStep, yv));
    }
    const cd = d3.contours().size([Wg, Hg]).thresholds([0.5])(vals);
    const pg = d3.geoPath().projection(
      d3.geoTransform({ point(c, r) { this.stream.point(xSc(xDom[0]+c*xStep), ySc(yDom[1]-r*yStep)); } })
    );
    let gl = targetG.select(".boundary-glow");
    if (gl.empty()) gl = targetG.insert("g", ".point").attr("class", "boundary-glow");
    gl.selectAll("path").data(cd).join("path").attr("d", pg)
      .attr("fill","none").attr("stroke","rgba(250,204,21,0.15)").attr("stroke-width",12)
      .attr("stroke-linejoin","round").attr("opacity",0).transition().duration(700).attr("opacity",1);
    let ln = targetG.select(".boundary-line");
    if (ln.empty()) ln = targetG.insert("g", ".point").attr("class", "boundary-line");
    ln.selectAll("path").data(cd).join("path").attr("d", pg)
      .attr("fill","none").attr("stroke","#fbbf24").attr("stroke-width",2)
      .attr("stroke-dasharray","7 4").attr("stroke-linejoin","round")
      .attr("opacity",0).transition().duration(700).attr("opacity",0.9);
  };

  window._drawBoundary = () => drawContour(plotArea, xScale, yScale);

  // ── Test chart draw function (redraws on slider change if model exists) ─────
  window._drawTestChart = () => {
    const m = window._model;
    if (!m || !m.predictNorm) return;
    const tc = document.getElementById("test-chart-container");
    if (!tc) return;
    const empty = document.getElementById("test-chart-empty");
    if (empty) empty.style.display = "none";

    const sz = Math.max((tc.clientWidth || 520) - 30, 320);
    const marg = {top: 24, right: 24, bottom: 48, left: 52};
    const iW = sz - marg.left - marg.right, iH = sz - marg.top - marg.bottom;
    const xSc = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4, 10]).range([0, iW]);
    const ySc = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4, 10]).range([iH, 0]);

    let tsvg = d3.select("#test-chart-container svg");
    if (tsvg.empty()) {
      tsvg = d3.select("#test-chart-container").append("svg")
        .attr("width", sz).attr("height", sz).style("display", "block");
    } else { tsvg.attr("width", sz).attr("height", sz); }

    let tdefs = tsvg.select("defs");
    if (tdefs.empty()) tdefs = tsvg.append("defs");
    let tclip = tdefs.select("#test-clip");
    if (tclip.empty()) {
      tclip = tdefs.append("clipPath").attr("id", "test-clip");
      tclip.append("rect");
    }
    tclip.select("rect").attr("width", iW).attr("height", iH);

    let tg = tsvg.select("g.inner");
    if (tg.empty()) tg = tsvg.append("g").attr("class","inner").attr("transform",`translate(${marg.left},${marg.top})`);

    let tPlotArea = tg.select(".plot-area");
    if (tPlotArea.empty()) {
      tPlotArea = tg.append("g").attr("class", "plot-area").attr("clip-path", "url(#test-clip)");
    }

    // Grid
    let gridG = tg.select(".grid"); if (gridG.empty()) gridG = tg.append("g").attr("class","grid");
    gridG.selectAll(".gh").data(ySc.ticks(6)).join("line").attr("class","gh")
      .attr("x1",0).attr("x2",iW).attr("y1",d=>ySc(d)).attr("y2",d=>ySc(d))
      .attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.05)").attr("stroke-width",1);
    gridG.selectAll(".gv").data(xSc.ticks(6)).join("line").attr("class","gv")
      .attr("x1",d=>xSc(d)).attr("x2",d=>xSc(d)).attr("y1",0).attr("y2",iH)
      .attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.05)").attr("stroke-width",1);

    // Axes
    let xAg = tg.select(".x-axis"); if (xAg.empty()) xAg = tg.append("g").attr("class","x-axis");
    xAg.attr("transform",`translate(0,${iH})`).call(d3.axisBottom(xSc).ticks(6).tickSize(4))
      .call(ax => { ax.select(".domain").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.15)");
        ax.selectAll("text").attr("fill","#64748b").attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
        ax.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"); });
    let yAg = tg.select(".y-axis"); if (yAg.empty()) yAg = tg.append("g").attr("class","y-axis");
    yAg.call(d3.axisLeft(ySc).ticks(6).tickSize(4))
      .call(ax => { ax.select(".domain").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.15)");
        ax.selectAll("text").attr("fill","#64748b").attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
        ax.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"); });

    // Test points (colored by true class, shaped by group)
    const sym = d3.symbol();
    const getTestX = d => {
      const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.test_group, d.test_class));
      return xSc(nx + (d.test_group === "Female" ? group_disparity : 0));
    };
    const getTestY = d => {
      const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.test_group, d.test_class));
      return ySc(ny + (d.test_class === "Positive" ? class_separation : 0));
    };
    const getTestColor = d => d.test_class === "Positive" ? "#1f77b4" : "#d62728";
    const getTestPath = (d, s) => { sym.type(d.test_group==="Male" ? d3.symbolCircle : d3.symbolCross).size(s); return sym(); };

    tPlotArea.selectAll("path.tpoint")
      .data(test_pool, d => d.id)
      .join(
        enter => enter.append("path").attr("class","tpoint")
          .attr("transform", d => `translate(${getTestX(d)},${getTestY(d)})`)
          .attr("d", d => getTestPath(d, 0)).attr("fill", getTestColor).attr("opacity",0)
          .call(e => e.transition().duration(450).attr("d", d=>getTestPath(d,60)).attr("opacity",0.72)),
        update => update.call(u => u.transition().duration(450)
          .attr("transform", d => `translate(${getTestX(d)},${getTestY(d)})`)
          .attr("d", d => getTestPath(d,60)).attr("fill", getTestColor).attr("opacity",0.72)),
        exit => exit.call(x => x.transition().duration(280).attr("d",d=>getTestPath(d,0)).attr("opacity",0).remove())
      );

    // Decision boundary on test chart
    drawContour(tPlotArea, xSc, ySc);
  };

  if (window._model) { window._drawBoundary(); window._drawTestChart(); }

  return null;
}
```
